name: Diphosphates
aliases: E450, E450(i), E450(ii), E450(iii), E450(v), E450(vi), E450(vii), INS 450, diphosphates, disodium diphosphate, trisodium diphosphate, tetrasodium diphosphate, tetrapotassium diphosphate, dicalcium diphosphate, calcium dihydrogen diphosphate, pyrophosphates, sodium acid pyrophosphate, SAPP, difosfatos, pirofosfatos
what_is: Diphosphates, E450, are additives used to control the texture of some foods, help them hold water, or make certain doughs rise.
why_botia: In the French NutriNet-Santé observational cohort of 92,000 adults, higher E450 intake was associated with a higher incidence of premenopausal breast cancer (HR 1.45, 95% CI 1.04-2.02). This association does not establish causation and needs confirmation in further research. No statistically significant association was observed in postmenopausal women in this study.
can_1: Detect E450, diphosphates, pyrophosphates and their common individual names when they are declared on the label.
can_2: Explain their use in food and show the Woman, Texture and E-number information layers.
cannot_1: Determine how much E450 a product contains when the amount is not declared.
cannot_2: Determine from the ingredient list whether a person's intake corresponds to the higher-intake group studied in NutriNet-Santé.

title: Diphosphates
description: An observational NutriNet-Santé study associated higher E450 intake with premenopausal breast cancer. This does not establish causation.
robot_answers: Because different phosphates provide phosphorus, and the relevant exposure does not depend on a single E number. The label identifies E450, but assessing exposure requires considering all sources of phosphate and phosphorus.

Because diphosphates are used mainly for technological functions such as leavening, water retention and texture control. They can work at relatively small amounts and are not added to give the product a distinctive flavour.
